compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
- dd-5: Unit tests written and passing for all new logic

GREEN implementation that turns RED tests (tasks 1–4) green. dd-1 through dd-4 tested by tasks 1–5; this task makes those tests pass.

## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] fetcher.py defines SilentTruncationError inline
  Verify: grep -E 'class SilentTruncationError' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py exposes _iter_pages generator and collect wrapper
  Verify: grep -E 'def _iter_pages|def collect' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py uses the new JQL string
  Verify: grep -F 'project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] fetcher.py emits dedup BRIDGE_ALERT via alert_store
  Verify: grep -F 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py && grep -F 'alert_store' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py
- [ ] All four new unit tests + modified snapshot test pass (GREEN confirmation)
  Verify: pytest -xvs tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_snapshot.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py

## Implementation Notes
- Refactor plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py:
  - Add _iter_pages(jql) generator yielding one page (list of issue dicts)
  - Add collect(jql) wrapper maintaining seen_keys: set[str] and snapshot: dict[str, dict]
  - Update JQL constant to: project = DIG AND (resolution = Unresolved OR updated >= -1h)
  - Inline per-page truncation gate: page returns exactly page_size (100) AND cumulative len(snapshot) >= 1000 AND ACLI total/isLast does NOT strictly confirm '<1000 in working set' → raise SilentTruncationError
  - Fallback same-token-twice gate: if start_at value or nextPageToken repeats across two consecutive pages with identical first key → raise SilentTruncationError(reason='same-token-twice')
  - Per-issue dedup: if key in seen_keys → alert_store.write('fetcher-dedup-suppressed', {'key': key}); continue
  - Define SilentTruncationError inline (following RescheduleError pattern in applier.py:33)
- Reuse alert_store.py — do NOT create a new bridge_alerts module
- Do NOT modify differ.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): The public API fetch_snapshot(pass_id, repo_root) MUST be preserved with identical signature — reconcile.py:71 calls it. Refactor it to compose collect() + JSON write to bridge_state/snapshots/<pass_id>.json. reconcile.py is NOT modified by this task.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): ACLI semantics correction. plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py:752-796 shows search_issues(jql, start_at, max_results) returns a plain list slice (list[dict]) — NO total field, NO isLast field, NO pageToken returned. Reformulate the truncation gate without depending on those: trigger SilentTruncationError when cumulative collected >= 1000 AND the most recent page returned exactly page_size (100) AND no signal confirms working-set <1000. The epic Approach text references metadata/tokens that the current ACLI surface does not expose — implement the inferred-from-page-size form; if a future ACLI version exposes total/isLast/pageToken, layer that confirmation in additively.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): alert_store API is append(record, repo_root) NOT write(kind, dict). Per-issue dedup must call: alert_store.append({'alert': 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed', 'key': <jira_key>, ...}, repo_root). Keep the grep for 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' string; update the AC grep for 'alert_store' to match the append() call site.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): Dedup-scope clarification — the dedup in this task is INTRA-snapshot (same jira_key appearing in overlapping page ranges from ACLI mid-fetch). It is NOT cross-pass mutation dedup. The story description's 'Per-issue mutation dedup in differ' refers to the structural invariant that the snapshot dict the differ consumes has each key at most once — that invariant is enforced HERE at the fetcher and reaches differ.py without code change to differ.py. Cross-pass mutation dedup, if needed, is OUT OF SCOPE for this story (sibling cde1-30ba owns canonical manifest).
comments.author: Test
